# Apply filter for 4 travelers (num_people=4) and the specified dates

    prior_results=hotels,
    checkin_date=["2025-07-09"],
    checkout_date=["2025-07-19"],
    num_people=4
)

    hotels=hotels,
    attractions=get_results_from_cache(key="attractions"),
    groupBy="hotel"
